transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess it’s about elevators. I know they’re not really dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get scared I’ll be trapped, and I just… can’t make myself feel normal about it.
Is your fear limited to elevators, or do you also feel uneasy in other situations like crowded places, open spaces, or leaving your home?
It’s really elevators. I mean, I know they’re not actually that dangerous, but once I have to get in one, I get this fear I’ll be trapped in there. That’s the thing I can’t shake.
Do you avoid using elevators altogether, or does this fear affect your ability to do things you need to do in your daily life?

I mostly avoid them. I take the stairs at my apartment and at work sites most days. If there’s no other way up, I’ll ask to do something else… or I’ll only get on if someone I trust is right there with me.
When you’re in an elevator, do you ever experience sudden feelings of intense fear or panic, like your heart racing, sweating, or feeling like you can’t breathe?
Yeah… it hits pretty fast. As soon as the doors start closing, my chest tightens up, my hands get sweaty, and I just keep thinking I need to get out, even if it’s only a few floors.
Have you ever felt this kind of fear in any other situation besides elevators, like using escalators, standing in line, or being in tight spaces?
Not really… it’s mainly elevators. I know they’re not really dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get scared I’m going to be trapped, and I just can’t make myself feel normal about it.
Have you ever had a panic attack or intense fear in situations other than elevators, like in public places, on public transport, or in open spaces?
No… not really. It’s just elevators. I know they’re not actually dangerous, but once I have to get in one, I get scared I’m going to be trapped, and I can’t really talk myself out of it.
Have you ever worried about having a panic attack in other situations, even when you’re not near an elevator?
No… I don’t think so. I don’t really worry about it unless an elevator’s involved.
Do you ever feel anxious about being in other situations where it might be hard to escape or get help, like being in a car, on a bus, or in a crowded room?

Not really… cars or buses don’t bother me like that. It’s mostly elevators. I know they’re not really dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get this fear I’m going to be stuck in there, and I can’t really shake it.
